haiku.problem: The verse is a rhetorical question ("Can a man hide...?"), not a statement by the LORD. Framing it as "the LORD said a man can hide" misstates what He said, even though the answer False is correct.
The verse says the prophets "suppose" their dreams will make God's people forget His name. "Hoped" changes the meaning from believing to wishing.
The question asks "Where did these prophets get the words?" but the answers are not places. Under the rules, a "where" question needs place answers. "How" or "From whom" would fit.
